levels.surface: إبراهيم بن خالد الكلبي أبو ثور

notes: «كنت عند ابن عمر» places أبيه in Ibn Umar's presence; Ibn Umar is a scene person and his own remark is not the relayed saying (rule 6), so he is not a link
«قال شيخ عنده» is an unnamed listener (rule 8); the saying's last link is Abu Hurayra
The Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link
